name: komdosh-architect
description: Evidence-driven software architecture design, review, visualization, acceptance, and delivery handoff in one compact plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Designs and reviews evidence-backed software architecture.
interface.longDescription: Komdosh Architect handles architecture discovery, design, review, diagrams, stakeholder acceptance, and delivery handoff without forcing a fixed stage sequence or loading unrelated guidance.
defaultPrompt: Use $komdosh-architect:architecture to review this system and lead with concrete blockers.
Use $komdosh-architect:architecture to design the smallest architecture needed for this change.
Use $komdosh-architect:architecture to turn this accepted design into a delivery-ready handoff.
